chat.body: Why does EditPokemonPage load the Pokemon without a request to /api/trpc?

`~/trpc/server` builds `api` with `createCaller`, so on the server `api.pokemon.byId(...)` runs the `byId` procedure in the same process. Only `PokemonForm` runs in the browser, and its `api.pokemon.update.useMutation()` goes through `/api/trpc`.
